newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Airliner Tunis Air propels Tunis bourse.
newsitem.headline: Airliner Tunis Air propels Tunis bourse.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Monday closed up by 1.46 percent, boosted by airliner Tunis Air, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 509.80 from 502.47 on Friday.
Total volume was 1.53 million dinars against 8.49 million dinars. Turnover on the first market was 948,167 from 707,753 over the previous session.

Airliner Tunis Air was up 2.22 dinars to 22 dinars with 13,918 shares changing hands. The rise followed the nomination last Saturday of former Transport and Tourism Minister Ahmed Smaoui as chairman of the company.

Insurance company ASTREE gained 1.04 dinars to 36.28 dinars. BTEI bank won 0.5 dinar to 24. Palm Beach Hotels was up 0.33 dinar to 11.33 dinars. Chemical firm Al-Kimia rose 0.2 dinar to 45.2. ($1= 1.08 dinar)
